name: 26746-prefillheavy-qwen3next80b-4gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bfloat16, unquantized. 41 shards, ~152 GB of weights, ~40.7 GB per rank at TP=4; it must be resident before a run.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one node, one allocation, NVLink, bare metal.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=30 req/s, bounded at 500 requests / 900 s safety, no warmup and no cooldown fraction: the statistics are over all 500 requests.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied. Prompt exactly 2048 tokens and output exactly 121 tokens (min = max), temperature 0.0, seed 26746 static.
purpose: A document analysis service summarizing long reports with an 80-billion-parameter model at thirty requests per second on four GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only. An indented line is skipped, so a structured value must stay on ONE
# line or the key is dropped and the engine starts without it.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4

# Pinned rather than defaulted: at this engine version the default pair depends on how the engine
# is constructed, so leaving either unset silently runs a different operating point.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

# Unset, the engine would take the checkpoint's 262144. The longest request here is 2169 tokens.
max-model-len: 4096

# This engine's own default, written down so a change of default cannot move the block pool.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
